blocks.text: In khasiyaton ke genes dono jinson mein hote hain lekin jismani banawat (anatomy) ya hormones ke farq ki wajah se sirf aik jins mein zahir hote hain. Inhein sex-limited traits kehte hain. Misaal: nar aur maada bhed (sheep) dono mein seengon ki nashonuma ke genes hote hain, lekin yeh sirf nar bhed mein zahir hote hain. Isi tarah doodh banane ke genes nar aur maada dono mammals mein hote hain, lekin sirf maada mein zahir hote hain. Insanon mein daarhi ugne ke genes sirf mardon mein zahir hote hain. Isi tarah prostate cancer ke genes sirf mardon mein aur ovarian cancer ke genes sirf auraton mein zahir hote hain, halanke yeh dono genes mardon aur auraton dono mein maujood hote hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Sex-limited genes sexual dimorphism ke zimmedar hain, yaani aik hi species ke nar aur maada ke phenotype (shakal o surat) mein farq, genotype chahe kuch bhi ho.
